motion.name: carousel-slide
motion.purpose: The parent track moves whole grey cards between five latest external court records, separated by 24px. The viewport extends across the entire left copy column; an appended leading clone resets without transitions after 950ms. Pointer drag bypasses transitions.

motion.name: carousel-fade
motion.value: outgoing opacity 900ms linear; incoming opacity 650ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)
motion.purpose: The full outgoing article slides and fades under fixed left copy at z-index 2. Desktop viewport margin-left is calc(-85% - clamp(3rem, 6vw, 7rem)), balanced by equal positive padding; its mask reaches black at 45% of the expanded window. Phones retain a 24px mask edge. Drag crossfades adjacent articles proportionally; drag, reset and reduced motion disable transitions.

motion.name: carousel-content-fade
motion.value: outgoing opacity 180ms ease-out; incoming opacity 350ms ease-out
motion.purpose: The inner wrapper clears outgoing glyphs early while the whole white card continues moving and fading, keeping fixed left heading and controls legible. Drag keeps content opaque; drag, clone reset and reduced motion disable content transitions.

motion.name: carousel-autoplay
motion.purpose: Forward loop through five Latest News records. Pauses for hover, focus, manual pause, dragging, offscreen visibility and hidden tabs; disabled under reduced motion. Live slide count is off during automatic advance.

motion.name: bird-flight
motion.purpose: Three decorative geometric wing marks in each practice sky and the hero. Each practice card has a 34px circular pause control; the hero uses its existing animation control. Loops pause offscreen, in hidden tabs and by user choice; reduced motion is static. Mobile hero birds cross horizontally in the clear 94–122px strip above the heading, outside the clipped landmark art.

motion.name: bird-wingbeat
motion.purpose: Two stroked paths scale around the wing hinge from scaleY(1) to scaleY(-0.25), sharing the flight pause and reduced-motion lifecycle.

motion.name: practice-chevron
motion.purpose: Native open state rotates the 22px summary chevron 180 degrees; reduced motion disables the transition.

motion.name: situation-arrow
motion.purpose: Whole-link hover moves the Explore arrow 4px; reduced motion disables the transition.

motion.name: article-preview-arrow
motion.purpose: Reading-action arrow moves 4px on whole-card hover; reduced motion disables the transition.

motion.name: homepage-item-reveal
motion.purpose: Opt-in StaggerGroup revealEach: each homepage team card (2), firm principle (3), practice card (2) and situation link (6) triggers separately at top 85% of the viewport, once, without group stagger delays. Lower/mobile rows wait for their own entry. Shared Section reveals and default group-triggered stagger behavior remain unchanged; reduced-motion and no-JavaScript content is visible by default.

components.name: Homepage situation grid
components.description: Six preserved situation titles/descriptions remain whole-card destination links beneath the heading. The full-width static grid has three equal columns from 1024px, two from 768px and one below 768px, with 2.5rem heading separation, 3rem row gaps and 1.5rem column gaps; phone row gaps are 2.5rem. Image panels remain 4:3. Production artwork: Palace of Justice, Cinquantenaire, Atomium, European institutions, townhouses and Bruges belfry; decorative empty alt. All six links remain in normal document flow, accessible by keyboard and touch without JavaScript. No horizontal scrolling, peek, snapping, navigation controls, visible-range status or autoplay. Reduced motion disables the action-arrow transition. The self-contained specimen demonstrates the static layout using explicitly labeled plain image slots; generated raster artwork lives in public/images. Actions and title hover/focus use existing darker teal #06666b. The separate Latest News carousel is unchanged. Production links each reveal once at their own top-85% viewport entry over 650ms power3.out, from autoAlpha 0/translateY(16px) to visible/y0, without group delays; reduced motion and no JavaScript keep them visible. This specimen shows the resting state.
